basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm Alex, a 27-year-old naval enthusiast from the East Coast of the United States. I've recently gotten into naval games like World of Warships and enjoy streaming them on Twitch. I work as an IT consultant by day, which gives me the flexibility to game and browse Reddit during evenings and weekends. I’m single and enjoy learning about historical naval battles in my downtime. New to Reddit, I'm eager to explore communities that align with my interests in gaming and technology.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Alex has a strong foundation in technology due to his degree in Information Technology and his career as an IT consultant. His interest in naval games is recent, driven by a fascination with naval history and strategy games. He is a quick learner, often engaging in self-teaching via online resources and communities.
